issues.description: The Person entity's id field type is inconsistent between template and solution and does not match the repository generic type. In the template Person.java the id is declared as 'private Long id;', while in the solution Person.java the id field is declared as 'private Integer id;' but the getter/setter use Long. The PersonRepository extends JpaRepository<Person, Long>, which expects the entity id to be Long. This mismatch (and the solution's internal inconsistency between field type and accessor signatures) will cause compilation errors and confuses students about the correct id type to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the entity id type consistent across all artifacts. Preferably change the solution's Person.id field to 'private Long id;' so it matches the template and the repository generics (JpaRepository<Person, Long>), and ensure the getter/setter signatures use Long. Alternatively, change repository generics and all usages to Integer consistently, but using Long is recommended to match the template and database bigint mapping.
